name: dsh-htb-skills
description: HTB (Hack The Box) pentesting framework for DeepSeek Harness: 164 distilled technique cards (T1 routing / T2 deep-dive / T3 reference tiers), a fact/intent state ledger (htb_fact / htb_frontier / htb_brief), five observation & guard modules (red-line, ask, writeup, struggle stop-protocol gate, context hygiene, error classify, front tracking), six htb_sherlock_* tools for the HTB labs API, plus a companion router plugin under router/. No browser half, no routes.
